jobs.jobDescription:
About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Justin Howie, Head of Brand Studio at Customer.io, and I'm looking for a Senior Brand Designer to join our small, close-knit creative team.

Brand Studio is the creative engine behind how Customer.io shows up in the world, from product launches and campaigns to the website and live events. We move fast, care deeply about craft, and operate at the intersection of strategy and production.

Our team is moving from a production function to a systems and platform team, powered by AI and self-serve tooling. AI sits at the center of how we work, and you'll shape how Brand Studio and the wider company use it for ideation, production, and self-serve creation. You'll own brand design execution across our biggest moments, and you'll build the templates, components, and AI-assisted workflows that let the rest of the company create on brand without waiting on us. You'll work closely with our Brand Designers, Motion Designer, Web Engineer, Product Designers, and Marketers.

This is a senior role with a runway. We're looking for a highly seasoned designer with strong business acumen, who manages up well and mentors others, and who we expect to grow into a Staff or Art Director role once you've proven yourself here.

If you lead with Design Craft, live at the frontier of AI for brand and creative, and want to build systems that help a whole company look and sound like one brand, this role is for you.

What we value

  • Design Craft with speed — You hold high standards and know how to hit deadlines.
  • Curiosity about what's next — You stay on the leading edge of brand and creative, from new AI tools to new techniques, and you share what you learn.
  • AI-native by default — You reach for AI first, test what works on real projects, and teach others how.
  • Collaboration over silos — You work closely with designers, developers, and marketers, and the output gets better because of it.
  • Bias for action — You'd rather ship something great and iterate than wait for perfect, and you're energized by building.
  • Clear communication — You ask the right questions, set clear expectations, and keep stakeholders in the loop without being asked.
  • Leadership beyond the work — You mentor the people around you, manage up with confidence, and think like an owner of the business.

What you’ll do

  • Own brand design execution for product launches, using AI-native workflows to take concepts to launch-ready assets in days
  • Design website pages, templates, and components in close collaboration with our Senior Web Engineer
  • Develop campaign assets for digital and out-of-home advertising, produced with AI-native workflows so we can test more concepts and ship more variants
  • Design branded materials for events and conferences, including signage, stage graphics, and collateral
  • Build and maintain brand templates and libraries, including Figma libraries, prompt libraries, and custom tooling that turn our guidelines into on-brand output anyone can use
  • Own our AI creative stack: choose the tools, set the standards, and share what you learn with Brand Studio and the wider company
  • Enable teams across the org through workshops, playbooks, and guardrails that keep AI-assisted work on brand
  • Translate briefs from Product Marketing and Demand Generation into creative concepts, executed end to end
  • Partner with Product Design to keep brand and product expression aligned
  • Mentor designers on the team, give clear critique, and raise the Design Craft bar across Brand Studio
  • Work with Brand Studio leadership and senior stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, and the business case for creative investment

What we're looking for

  • 7+ years of hands-on brand or visual design experience, ideally in-house at a B2B SaaS or tech company, with a record of senior-level ownership
  • A portfolio that shows range: brand systems, campaign work, product launch design, web and landing pages, event and out-of-home, and AI-assisted work with a clear account of your process
  • Expert proficiency in Figma, including building and maintaining components and libraries within a brand system, and fluency in Adobe Creative Suite
  • Strong typography and layout instincts, and a track record of turning complex technical concepts into clear, compelling visuals
  • Business acumen: you connect design decisions to company goals, make the case for creative investment, and communicate fluently with executives
  • The ability to manage up and lead without authority: setting expectations, surfacing risks early, and driving alignment across Marketing, Product, and Exec
  • Mentorship experience: you've coached other designers and raised the craft bar around you
  • Deep, hands-on experience with AI image and design tools in your production workflow, plus fluency across the AI creative stack (image generation, LLMs, prompt design, workflow automation) with examples of workflows, templates, or tools you've built that help others create on brand

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. Starting salary for this role is $128k–$160k USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

We know our people are what make us great, and we’re committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. 30-minute Zoom with a Recruiter
  2. 45-minute Zoom with the Head of Brand Studio
  3. 30-minute Zoom with a cross-functional leader
  4. 45-minute Zoom portfolio review and design exercise with Brand Studio

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read — apply now.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team:

Web Presence & Platform (WPP) is organized into two pillars: Platform and Presence. The Platform pillar builds internal systems, tooling, and infrastructure to support the web. The Presence pillar owns Stripe’s public-facing storytelling across stripe.com, including our homepage, product landing pages, industry and solutions pages, and other high-impact go-to-market surfaces. Together, we shape how millions of people understand what Stripe is and what it can do for them.

Designers on the Presence team work at the intersection of craft and impact—balancing clarity, polish, and systems thinking with strategic storytelling and experimentation. We collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, content, and product to deliver work that is not only beautiful, but measurably moves the business.

What you’ll do

As a Designer on the Presence team, you'll contribute to the strategy and execution of Stripe’s most visible web surfaces. You’ll design new product pages, evolve storytelling for specific industries or audiences, and refine reusable patterns that make it easier to scale exceptional work across stripe.com. This is a high-impact role for a thoughtful, collaborative designer who deeply values visual craft, user clarity, and iteration.

We’re looking for someone who’s excited to operate at the intersection of storytelling, systems, and scale—and who takes pride in the pixels. Your work will directly shape how millions of users understand Stripe, and help convert interest into action across a range of audiences—from founders to enterprise CTOs.

Responsibilities

  • Design new and improved experiences across stripe.com, including product, industry, and solution landing pages
  • Collaborate with engineers, PMMs, and content designers to define problems, explore solutions, and bring them to life
  • Partner with other designers to maintain and evolve systems that uphold Stripe’s design standards at scale
  • Balance storytelling with usability to create pages that are engaging, credible, and easy to navigate
  • Use user research, user testing, and data to guide and validate your decisions
  • Participate in critique and feedback sessions, contributing to the overall quality bar of the team
  • Demonstrate a meticulous attention to craft—ensuring designs are not only functional, but visually excellent

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these, we encourage you to apply—even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification.

Minimum requirements

  • 2–4 years of relevant design experience, ideally in web or product marketing contexts
  • A strong portfolio of web design work that demonstrates exceptional visual design skills, systems thinking, and attention to detail
  • Ability to independently scope and lead small to medium-sized projects
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset
  • Fluency in layout, typography, color, hierarchy, and interaction fundamentals
  • Comfortable using Figma and working in component-based systems
  • Experience working on CMS-driven websites and modular systems

Preferred qualifications

  • Familiarity with front-end development workflows or an ability to speak fluently with engineers
  • Understanding of web performance, accessibility, and SEO best practices
  • Experience designing for international audiences or multilingual websites
  • Previous experience in fast-paced, cross-functional environments

How we work

We care deeply about craft—but also about moving with urgency and focus. We seek feedback early and often, because we believe design gets stronger through collaboration and iteration. We keep our users front and center—whether that’s a small business owner evaluating Stripe for the first time, or a CTO trying to understand a complex product at a glance. And we take pride in delivering work that is not only beautiful and precise, but that delivers clear, measurable impact.

We value curiosity, humility, and resilience. You’ll do well here if you love to learn, enjoy working across disciplines, and bring energy and optimism into your work.

This is a great opportunity for someone eager to grow. Designers on the Presence team have gone on to lead major product launches, shape system-wide improvements, and take on leadership roles. You'll be supported by experienced peers and have space to develop your craft, influence, and ownership over time.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Please note: This role will require occasional travel to San Francisco.

The role

Nebius is looking for a Communications Designer, Developer Experience to be a part of the Design team and embedded with DevRel. At Nebius, we believe builders decide which platforms win. AI engineers, agent builders, ML engineers and inference teams choose what to build on long before it becomes a procurement decision — and we want to earn that choice early, while they're still picking their models, inference and tooling. This role is about making Nebius the brand those builders recognize, respect, and share.

You’re welcome to work remotely in the United States.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building and evolving the visual language for everything developer-facing — one system that holds together across the dev.nebius.com, AI Builder Program, social, events, swag, and developer community.
  • Designing for where builders actually are — meetups, hackathons, conference presence, event environments, and swag that developers actually want to wear and keep.
  • Designing web pages, developer program materials, campaign visuals, and social content for a technical audience.
  • Making technical content look as good as it is: benchmarks, GPU specs, pricing, architecture diagrams — turning dense material into visuals people actually want to read and share.
  • Creating AI-templates and guidelines so the DevRel team can produce on-brand materials at speed without a designer in every loop.
  • Working in the open with DevRel and content: quick concepts, tight iterations, ship-learn-repeat.

We expect you to have:

  • A portfolio of marketing that developers actually respect — launch pages, developer program sites, campaigns, event visuals, technical content. Engineers can smell fluff; you don't produce it.
  • You understand the audience: AI builders, ML engineers, DevOps, inference and platform teams, developers moving into AI. You know what catches their attention, what they ignore, and what makes them share something with a colleague.
  • You study the brands developers love — and can explain why their marketing lands with a technical audience, bringing that thinking into your own work.
  • Experience designing for physical spaces and events: booths, signage, environments, printed materials, swag — you understand print technologies, materials, and production constraints, and can take a design from concept to fabrication.
  • System-first mindset: a visual language that scales across surfaces, not a collection of one-offs.
  • AI-proficiency: up-to-date knowledge of AI tools and a strong critical eye for results — from a design expert's perspective, not an average user's.
  • Strong layout, composition, and information design skills: typography, grids, visual hierarchy, and the craft to keep dense technical material clear.
  • Ability to articulate and defend design decisions, incorporate feedback, and iterate quickly.
  • Excitement about defining what an AI cloud brand looks like for the people building on it. #LI-LT1

Key employee benefits in the US:

  • Health insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.
  • 401(k) plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.
  • Parental leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.
  • Remote work reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.
  • Disability & life insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage.

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range

$150,000—$187,500 USD

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.jobDescription:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

About the team

You’ll join a cross‑functional group of app monetization subject matter experts who partner directly with RevenueCat customers and prospects. As part of the broader Customer Growth org, this team designs and implements high‑impact paywalls, onboarding flows, and purchase funnels using RevenueCat’s no‑code builders and experimentation tools, then feeds learnings back into our product, templates, and educational content

You’ll also collaborate closely with our content, marketing, and advocacy teams to turn real‑world project outcomes into templates, case studies, webinars, and best‑practice guides for the broader app community

About the role

As Senior CRO Designer, Paywalls & Funnels, you’ll be the person RevenueCat customers trust when the question is: “How do we get more users to convert and stay subscribed?”

You will:

  • Design & build high‑converting paywalls and funnels

    • Use RevenueCat’s paywall and experiment builders to design, configure, and ship paywalls, onboarding flows, upgrade paths, and win‑back experiences for mobile apps across categories

    • Translate brands and product value props into clear, compelling paywall layouts, messaging, and pricing presentations

  • Lead conversion optimization projects for customers and prospects

    • Run structured discovery with customers and prospects to understand their business model, audience, and constraints

    • Propose experiment plans (e.g., value prop framing, pricing presentation, trial vs. no‑trial, placement and timing of paywalls)

    • Partner with apps to launch multivariate tests and interpret results, using RevenueCat’s analytics and experimentation tooling

  • Codify patterns into reusable assets

    • Distill what’s working across projects into reusable templates, checklists, and patterns that can be implemented directly in RevenueCat’s builders

    • Work with Product to inform our paywall components, presets, and default templates

  • Create educational content with Advocacy & Marketing

    • Collaborate with Growth Advocacy and Content teams to turn your project learnings into:

      • Example paywalls and funnel templates

      • Blog posts, guides, and best‑practice documentation

      • Webinars, live reviews, and conference talks or workshops

    • Participate in public‑facing sessions (e.g., teardown streams, office hours) as a visible expert on monetization UX

  • Champion monetization UX best practices

    • Advise Sales, Customer Success, and Support on paywall and funnel best practices they can bring into customer conversations

    • Provide feedback to Product & Engineering on how practitioners use our builders in the wild, highlighting opportunities for new features, components, and workflows

About you

You’re a conversion‑focused designer who lives at the intersection of mobile product design, growth, and experimentation. You have a track record of shipping real paywalls and funnels that move business metrics, not just portfolios

You have:

  • Deep hands‑on experience with paywalls & funnels

    • 5–8+ years designing consumer mobile experiences, with a substantial portion spent on subscription or purchase flows (e.g., paywalls, onboarding, upgrade/upsell, win‑back, account limits)

    • Experience either:

      • At a mobile app studio / product team owning monetization UX, or

      • At an agency/consultancy repeatedly designing and optimizing paywalls and funnels for multiple apps

  • Strong conversion & experimentation mindset

    • Comfort defining hypotheses, success metrics, and test plans (e.g., CVR, trial start rate, activation, LTV)

    • Experience using analytics and experimentation tools to interpret results and iterate quickly

    • Ability to balance conversion gains with long‑term user trust and platform guidelines

  • Mobile‑first product design skills

    • Excellent interaction and visual design chops for small screens and high‑stakes surfaces (like paywalls and purchase flows)

    • Strong UX writing instincts for concise, value‑focused copy and pricing messaging

    • Proficiency in modern design tools (e.g. Figma) and comfort translating designs into no‑code builder configurations

  • Customer‑facing communication skills

    • Confidence leading workshops, design reviews, and strategy sessions with customers and prospects

    • Ability to present options, pros/cons, and trade‑offs to both designers and non‑design stakeholders (founders, PMs, marketers)

    • Great written communication for async collaboration in a remote team

  • Values & ways of working

    • You’re energized by our mission to help developers make more money

    • You work iteratively and ship value quickly rather than waiting for perfection

    • You have an ownership mentality: You see broken or unclear experiences and feel compelled to improve them

    • You’re comfortable working in a fully remote, distributed team and collaborating across time zones

In your first month, you’ll:

  • Learn RevenueCat’s products, especially paywalls, experiments, and analytics

  • Join customer calls to understand our process and common challenges

  • Audit a handful of existing customer paywalls and funnels and build your first recommendations

Within 3 months, you’ll:

  • Own several customer projects end‑to‑end, from discovery through experiment analysis

  • Ship multiple paywall and funnel variations using RevenueCat’s builders

  • Partner with Advocacy/Content on at least one public asset (template, blog post, teardown, or webinar segment)

Within 6 months, you’ll:

  • Be the go‑to expert internally for monetization UX, paywall patterns, and funnel optimization

  • Maintain and evolve an internal “playbook” of best practices and tested patterns

  • Influence the roadmap for our paywall and experiment tooling based on patterns you see across customers

Within 12 months, you’ll:

  • Have materially improved conversion for a portfolio of customer apps, with clear before/after stories

  • Help define our strategy for paywall templates and monetization UX guidance at scale

  • Represent RevenueCat in public‑facing educational content (webinars, AMAs, workshops, or conference talks) as a leading voice on mobile monetization UX

What we offer:

  • Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

  • 10-year window to exercise vested equity options

  • A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

  • 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

  • Paid desk at a co-working space

  • Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat, including tips to help you succeed.

More on how we work:

  • How we think about hiring and team design: Building a Winning Team

  • The values that guide how we work: Our Values

  • How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat

  • What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations

  • What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

NetBox Labs seeks a Senior Product Designer to help shape the next generation of our platform. We are building products on top of the NetBox data model that help network teams put their data to work, from interactive maps of their network, to compliance on network intended design, to analytics and AI-driven workflows. This role will own design across these applications and how they connect to each other. You will partner with product managers and engineers on day-to-day delivery, and with design leadership on building a design culture and scaling how design works across the company.

Who you are

Curiosity drives you. You want to understand how networks actually run and why operators work the way they do. You love rolling up your sleeves and are as happy sketching a flow, building a prototype or sitting in on a customer call. You are energized by complex technical landscapes, where dense data, expert users and messy real-world systems bring out your best work. You have a sharp eye for great design, care about craft and clarity and can explain why something works and how to make it better.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end design for platform applications such as Analytics, Visual Explorer, Validation, orAI-driven workflows that customers use directly in the product.

  • Design how these applications interact with each other, NetBox, and our observability products.

  • Turn complex data sets, visualizations, and workflows into clear, usable interfaces for network engineers and architects.

  • Plan and run user research, both qualitative and quantitative, and bring customer insight back to product and engineering teams.

  • Prototype ideas quickly, whether with AI tools, in code, or in Figma, to test concepts with users and engineers.

  • Design in the open. Share work early, invite critique, and keep stakeholders aligned.

  • Contribute to our design system in Figma and partner with frontend engineers on the Storybook component library.

  • Shape how the design team uses AI in its process, and challenge how we work today.

  • Help improve how we use product analytics to inform design decisions.

  • Help define the long-term vision for the platform, exploring what comes next beyond your immediate product area.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of product design experience, including enterprise-grade B2B software.

  • Experience designing for technical users, such as network, DevOps, security, or infrastructure engineers.

  • A track record of taking products from MVP to GA, including shaping the first release and carrying the design through to a launch-ready product.

  • Comfort with complex data sets, data visualization, and multi-step workflows.

  • Strong visual design and interaction design skills, shown in a portfolio.

  • Hands-on experience planning and running user research, and acting on what you learn.

  • Active, effective use of AI in your design work, with examples of how it has changed your process.

  • Prototyping skills in any form, from AI tools to code to Figma.

  • Experience working on a design team inside a scale-up, alongside other designers.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, and a habit of designing in the open.

  • Experience in improving how a team works, not just what it ships.

  • Able to work with significant overlap with US Eastern and UK hours.

Nice to have:

  • Experience designing observability, monitoring, or compliance products.

  • Experience with network management or infrastructure software.

  • Experience using product analytics tools such as PostHog to inform design.

  • Familiarity with design systems built in Figma and Storybook.

Join NetBox Labs. Help design how network teams see, trust, and act on their data.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Customer.io

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Matt Wensing, VP of Product & Design at Customer.io, and I'm looking for a Principal Product Designer. Principal Product Designer is the highest individual contributor design role at Customer.io. This person shapes the design vision for the company and influences how design is practiced here — through their own craft, through the standards their work sets, and through the partnerships they build with product and engineering leadership.

Customer.io is in a transformational moment: executing against a strong current product while redesigning what the product is and how it's experienced by a new generation of builders. This role has to straddle both — delivering quality and coherence in what exists today while driving the vision for where things go.

This is not a management role, but it's a leadership role in the fullest sense. Their influence is felt company-wide — in the product, in the culture, and in who we hire.

About you

You have a fully formed point of view on how AI changes what software means — for the people who use it, the people who build it, and the agents that increasingly operate it. You have the conviction to put that view to work across a product and an organization. You lead through clarity and example, give candid feedback that improves the work, and operate with humility and curiosity even outside your own expertise.

What we value

  • Leads through clarity and example, not control. You shape culture through your own practice — not top-down direction.
  • Candid craft feedback. You give feedback that improves the work, even when it's uncomfortable.
  • Humility and curiosity. You operate with openness, especially in areas outside your expertise.
  • Amplifying others. You raise the impact of people across the whole company — not just the design team.
  • Bias for craft. You stay close to the work by choice, and that proximity is how you lead.

Some things you'll do

  • Shape and communicate a design vision for Customer.io's product as a whole — the coherent, long-range picture of what excellent looks like for our customers, brought into rooms where product direction gets set
  • Drive the strategic direction of Pluma, our design system — architecture, evolution, deprecation decisions, and the principles that govern how it scales
  • Close the gap between design intent and shipped product — stay close enough to implementation to catch divergence, and fix it directly when code is the right tool
  • Design for builder and developer audiences — CLI-native flows, API-first onboarding, and interfaces built for people who type before they click
  • Lead the design of agentic and human-AI surfaces across the product — develop the philosophy and advocate for the standards
  • Partner with product and engineering leadership on product strategy — bring design into the conversation before direction is set, not after
  • Develop and advocate for Customer.io's AI product design philosophy as a framework the whole team builds from
  • Lead design review for major initiatives and bring accountability for quality and coherence across what ships
  • Develop Staff designers through direct mentorship, critique, and the clarity of your own example
  • Contribute to hiring and calibration — assess candidates with conviction and help the team develop a shared language for what excellent looks like

What we're looking for

  • 10+ years of product design experience with a portfolio demonstrating design vision and organizational impact, not just individual craft
  • Track record of shaping design direction at the company level — influenced what gets built and why, not just how it looks
  • Designed for developer and builder audiences — CLI, API-first onboarding, or infrastructure-native products
  • Developed point of view on AI and agentic product design — has shipped AI-native interfaces and can articulate a philosophy on interaction models for agentic and delegated use
  • Contributed to a design system at the strategic level — shaped what it should be and shouldn't be, and advocated for those decisions over time
  • Operates with influence without authority — track record of aligning product, engineering, and exec leadership around a design direction without a management title
  • Has raised the craft bar at an organizational level — through critique culture, standards, and the example others internalize
  • Executive-level communication — connects design decisions to customer impact, product differentiation, and business outcomes
  • B2B SaaS depth — understands complex, data-heavy products and has opinions about where the interaction model breaks

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. The starting salary for this role is $245k-$276k USD, depending on experience and subject to market-rate adjustment. In addition to base salary, this role includes an equity grant in the form of stock options, so you share in the success you help build.

We know our people are what make us great, and we're committed to taking great care of them. Our inclusive benefits package supports your well-being and growth, including 100% coverage of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and supplemental insurance premiums for you and your family. We also offer 16 weeks of paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

See full benefits here →

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions — just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  • 30 minute call with Recruiter
  • 45 minute call and portfolio review with Hiring Manager
  • 30 minute call with cross-functional partner
  • 60 minute design case call with members of the design & tech team

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions, please contact jobs@customer.io.

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you're excited by what you read — apply now.

jobs.jobDescription:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We’re a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees– our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

Design at Tremendous

We design experiences that make complex systems feel straightforward and intuitive by taking our time to get things right. We favor depth and scale over speed, while raising the bar for quality so our product stays ahead of the competition. We’re a place for designers who care about doing things well.

About the role

We're hiring a Senior Product Designer to raise the craft of the product across Tremendous.

You'll report to our Director of Product Design and work horizontally. Craft projects across the dashboard and the recipient experience: navigation, information architecture, the design system, motion. You'll also take small projects from pods that have no designer. Those teams have little user experience work of their own, which is why this is a Foundations role.

What you'll do

  • Raise the craft of the product. Dashboard and recipient experience. Navigation, information architecture, how things open and close, empty states. Motion, micro-interactions, and transitions are a big part of the job.

  • Own the design system, and raise it. Set patterns other designers can follow with clear documentation. Close gaps that produce one-off UI. Push the quality of the system itself.

  • Set a vision for product foundations. Where craft, UX, and UI should go so the product holds up next to Stripe or Brex. Make that vision concrete enough to build toward.

  • Cover work that has no designer. Small projects from pods without an embedded designer.

  • Partner with an engineer. You'll work with an engineer focused on shipping this craft work with you. Use AI to prototype, show how something should feel, and help engineering implement it.

  • Designers at Tremendous own the copy in their designs.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years as a product designer, including experience working on B2B products. You can do the product thinking: edge cases, shipping work that has to hold up in a real product.

  • High craft. Strong visual design, UI, and motion. Your portfolio shows it.

  • You've owned and improved a design system.

  • You've done information architecture and set a product vision or redesign. You can tell that story.

  • Strong communication and storytelling, written and verbal.

  • You use AI in your design work, including prototyping (v0, Claude, Cursor, or similar).

What's cool about the role

  • Ship work you’ll be proud of.

  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $200,000 - $265,000.

  • Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.

  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.

  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Us

Fieldguide is establishing a new state of trust for global commerce and capital markets through automating and streamlining the work of assurance and audit practitioners specifically within cybersecurity, privacy, and financial audit. Put simply, we build software for the people who enable trust between businesses.

We’re based in San Francisco, CA, but built as a remote-first company that enables you to do your best work from anywhere. We're backed by top investors including Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, Bessemer Venture Partners, 8VC, Floodgate, Y Combinator, DNX Ventures, Global Founders Capital, Justin Kan, Elad Gil, and more.

We value diversity — in backgrounds and in experiences. We need people from all backgrounds and walks of life to help build the future of audit and advisory. Fieldguide’s team is inclusive, driven, humble and supportive. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture that we are building, seeking teammates that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but care deeply about supporting each other's growth.

As an early stage start-up employee, you’ll have the opportunity to build out the future of business trust. We make audit practitioners’ lives easier by bringing together up to 50% of their work and giving them better work-life balance. If you share our values and enthusiasm for building a great culture and product, you will find a home at Fieldguide.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Motion Designer to join the Fieldguide team. You’ll own the animations, product explainers, and campaign pieces that bring our product and brand to life. You'll take dense, technical product and brand concepts and turn them into visual stories that are sharp, credible, and engaging. This is a dedicated motion design seat: you'll partner closely with our creative team to set the standard for motion and animation at Fieldguide, and build the visual language for how we represent our product and its ideas in motion.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and animate motion graphics for brand videos, product explainers, campaign content, and event deliverables, translating technical and strategic concepts into visuals that resonate and connect with our audience.

  • Build the visual language for how we represent our product and its ideas in motion: UI animation, data visualization, conceptual/abstract sequences, and typography-driven storytelling.

  • Own and evolve our motion design system (transitions, iconography in motion, animation principles).

  • Work directly with brand, product marketing, and design to scope projects from concept through final delivery.

  • Partner with video editors on hybrid pieces, handing off or receiving cuts and layering in motion graphics, titles, and effects.

Who You Are

  • A strong portfolio of motion work that demonstrates visual storytelling, art direction, animation craft, and visual systems thinking.

  • A track record of making technical ideas visually clear. The ability to look at a paragraph of product or strategy language and see the animation in it.

  • Deep fluency in motion design tools and workflows such as After Effects, Figma, Cinema 4D, Lottie, Rive, code-adjacent motion, or comparable production tools.

  • Strong typography and systems thinking: you can build a visual language once and reuse it consistently across many pieces.

  • Comfortable working in Figma and collaborating directly with Product Designers to translate complex UI into marketing motion.

  • A team player who brings a unique sense of aesthetics and passion for bringing concepts to life.

More about Fieldguide:

Fieldguide is a values-based company. Our values are:

  • Fearless - Inspire & break down seemingly impossible walls.

  • Fast - Launch fast with excellence, iterate to perfection.

  • Lovable - Deliver happiness & 11 star experiences.

  • Owners - Execute & run the business with ownership.

  • Win-win - Create mutual value & earn trust for life.

  • Inclusive - Scale the best ideas with inclusive teams.

Some of our benefits include:

  • Competitive compensation packages with meaningful ownership

  • Flexible PTO

  • 401k

  • Wellness benefits

  • Technology & Work from Home reimbursement

  • Flexible work schedules

jobs.jobDescription:
Instrument is a design and technology company. We build brands, products, and experiences that move businesses forward—by making the complex simple.

For over 20 years, we’ve partnered with companies like Google, ServiceNow, Uber, Eventbrite, and ŌURA, helping them navigate change, launch new ideas, and grow with intention.

Our work spans Brand, Marketing, and Product, but what defines us is how we work. We bring strategy, design, and engineering together from the start, moving quickly from idea to execution and refining as we go. We aim to do great work and be great to work with, because both matter.

We’re a collaborative, hands-on team with roots in Portland and New York and a distributed presence across the U.S. and Europe. We build teams around the needs of the work, staying nimble without sacrificing craft.

We value curiosity, perspective, and continuous learning, and we’re committed to building an inclusive environment where people can do their best work.

If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you.

The Role

Great creative leadership starts with a powerful idea – and the ability to make that idea stronger at every step.

As a Creative Director at Instrument, you’ll set the creative vision for ambitious work spanning brand, identity and design systems, web, and digital experiences. You’ll lead from the idea outward: shaping the concept, pushing the craft, inspiring multidisciplinary teams, and building the kind of client trust that allows great work to happen.

We’re looking for an exceptional conceptual thinker and brand leader—a creative generalist with high taste, strong creative conviction, and the presence to bring both teams and senior clients along with a vision. Your foundation is in brand and conceptual creative, but your range extends beyond any one discipline. You’re equally energized by building a brand from the ground up, evolving an identity system, shaping a digital experience, or finding the big idea that connects them all.

Depending on the needs of the work, this role may span multiple accounts or focus deeply on a single client partnership. In either case, you’ll have the opportunity to build meaningful client relationships, develop a deep understanding of their business, and shape the creative vision across a range of challenges.

What You'll Do

  • Set and champion the creative vision across projects, developing big ideas that are strategically grounded, distinctive, and built to extend across different types of work.
  • Lead creative across brand, identity and design systems, web, and digital experiences, creating a strong through-line from concept through execution.
  • Maintain an exceptional bar for craft and originality, pushing the work and helping multidisciplinary teams deliver at their highest level.
  • Serve as a senior creative partner to clients, confidently presenting and selling ideas, navigating feedback and ambiguity, and building trust with senior stakeholders.
  • Lead and inspire multidisciplinary teams, bringing designers, writers, strategists, technologists, and producers together around a shared creative vision.
  • Balance multiple projects and creative workstreams while maintaining consistency, momentum, and quality.
  • Contribute to new business and account growth by shaping creative approaches, identifying opportunities, and helping turn ambitious ideas into compelling pitches and expanded partnerships.

What You'll Bring

  • Significant experience leading creative at an agency, studio, or similarly multidisciplinary environment, with demonstrated ownership of the creative vision from concept through execution.
  • An exceptional portfolio demonstrating big conceptual thinking, brand and identity work, and a consistently high bar for visual craft.
  • Deep expertise in brand and conceptual creative, paired with credible experience leading websites and other digital experiences.
  • The ability to develop and recognize powerful ideas and evolve them into cohesive creative systems and experiences.
  • Strong creative judgment and the ability to push teams beyond the expected while giving clear, actionable direction.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams and bringing different disciplines together around a shared vision.
  • A strong track record of presenting and selling creative work to senior clients, navigating complex conversations, and building lasting client trust.
  • Experience balancing and directing multiple creative workstreams without losing sight of the larger idea or quality of execution.
  • Comfort working with ambiguity and adapting your approach as the creative challenge, client, or medium changes.
  • A collaborative leadership style grounded in curiosity, clarity, high standards, and a genuine investment in helping others do their best work.

Pay Range

  • The expected pay range for this position is $150,000 - $200,000. This range reflects the potential compensation across multiple levels and U.S. geographic pay regions. Final compensation is determined by the candidate's level and their work location. Instrument uses three regional pay ranges to account for cost of living (US1 +15%, US2 +7.5%, US3 Base). Learn more about our pay philosophy and regional pay structure.

What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401k with employer matching
  • Unlimited PTO + company wide closures
  • Work From Home and Wellbeing monthly stipend
  • HSA Employer Contribution
  • Professional Development Stipend
  • Paid Parental Leave

Compensation

Additional Information

What We Offer

Flexible, Hybrid Work Environment

Great Compensation with Annual Reviews (Learn more about our Pay Philosophy)

401(k) Matching with Immediate Vesting

Robust Medical, Vision, and Accident Insurance

Generous Paid Holidays and unlimited PTO

Monthly Wellbeing Stipend

Career Management and Leadership Training

jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

The Associate Creative Director will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the visual and creative direction of the digital experience for a leading global B2B SaaS company. This role requires a blend of strategic thinking, hands-on design expertise, and collaboration across multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality creative assets that resonate with both business clients and internal stakeholders. This role also plays a key part in reimagining what our web and digital experiences can be in an AI-first world — moving beyond conventional page-building toward more interactive, memorable digital experiences for our customers.

This is a remote role open to candidates based in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the development and execution of creative concepts for digital, and multimedia marketing materials.
  • Own our tokenized digital web design system in Figma, with components mapped one-to-one to our codebase so that a single change cascades consistently across the entire site—coordinating with the Brand Creative team to ensure we show up in a consistent, evocative manner, and keeping the system structured for both designers and AI-assisted tools to build from.
  • Prototype and build directly using AI-assisted design and development tools, moving fluidly from concept toward a near-shippable experience rather than relying solely on a traditional design-to-engineering handoff.
  • Collaborate with product, marketing, and sales teams to create compelling visual narratives that align with brand strategy and business goals—including bringing an e-commerce and growth-oriented mindset to our web store, a fast-scaling, revenue-driving part of the business run more like a product than a typical marketing site.
  • Manage a team of digital designers and creative technologists, providing guidance, mentorship, and constructive feedback to ensure high standards of creative excellence.
  • Oversee the production process from ideation through to final delivery, ensuring projects meet deadlines, budgets, and quality expectations.
  • Contribute to the creation of brand guidelines and ensure consistency across all creative outputs.
  • Stay current on industry trends and emerging design tools—including AI-powered ones—integrating innovative techniques into the creative process.
  • Work closely with UX to ensure that our user insights are being delivered upon.
  • Analyze and optimize creative assets for performance across various digital channels, ensuring that designs drive engagement, conversions, and customer retention.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of experience in a creative role with 2+ years of experience as a direct people manager within a B2B SaaS or high-tech environment.
  • Expertise in design software such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects).
  • Experience and curiosity around AI models and tools for how they augment design workflows and condense time between design and development.
  • Hands-on experience working within a componentized or tokenized design system in Figma, ideally one connected to a live codebase.
  • Genuine, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted design or prototyping tools—you don't need to be a deep technologist, but you should already be building with these tools as part of your process, not just aware of them.
  • Strong understanding of brand strategy, UX/UI design principles, and digital marketing best practices.
  • Ability to translate user insights into compelling digital experiences.
  • Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, heatmaps, or A/B testing to understand how creative assets perform and optimize them accordingly.
  • Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, which can be helpful for collaborating with developers and understanding web-based project requirements.
  • Proven track record of managing cross-functional projects, collaborating with various teams, and delivering high-quality results under tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate creative concepts to non-design stakeholders.
  • A portfolio showcasing a range of creative work, including B2B marketing campaigns, digital experiences, and branding projects.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience designing for or partnering closely with an e-commerce or product-led-growth (PLG) motion, in addition to traditional marketing/brand work.
  • In-house experience at a fast-scaling company, in addition to or instead of agency experience.
  • Experience preparing or structuring a design system so it can be consumed by AI or MCP-based tooling, or tying a design system directly to a live codebase.
  • Proficiency in motion design tools like After Effects or Premiere Pro for creating dynamic content, video assets, and animations that complement creative campaigns.
  • Experience with 3D design software like Cinema 4D or Blender, adding depth and sophistication to projects.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$114,800—$205,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.jobDescription:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

This is a great opportunity to bring deep industrial design craft to how Hims & Hers builds the physical products that carry our brand into people's homes and daily routines. As a Staff Industrial Designer, you'll bring expert-level craft across multiple design disciplines and help build the design systems and frameworks that scale across our projects.

You'll be trusted with complex, ambiguous problems across multiple initiatives — anticipating design challenges before they surface and proposing scalable, innovative solutions. You'll shape creative direction for major projects, making independent decisions that meaningfully affect team output and brand quality.

This is a defined-term contract engagement supporting our industrial design team's active product roadmap. If you love solving hard, ambiguous design problems, partnering closely with cross-functional teams, and mentoring the designers around you, we'd love to talk.

This is a temporary position for 12 months.

You Will:

CRAFT EXPERTISE & DESIGN SYSTEMS

  • Bring expert craft across disciplines

    • Apply expert-level skill across multiple creative disciplines — sketching, CAD surfacing, CMF, and prototyping — to deliver work that holds up against a high craft bar.

    • Contribute to and help scale the design systems and frameworks that keep quality and consistency high as our project portfolio grows.

    • Use deep technical and conceptual expertise to drive innovation without sacrificing consistency across the products you touch.

  • Solve complex, ambiguous problems

    • Resolve complex, ambiguous design problems across multiple initiatives, not just a single project.

    • Anticipate design challenges before they become blockers, and propose scalable, innovative solutions.

    • Bring a point of view to ambiguous briefs and translate them into concrete design principles, sketches, and prototypes.

PROJECT OWNERSHIP & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP

  • Shape creative direction for major projects

    • Own creative direction for major projects or programs within the portfolio, making independent decisions that meaningfully affect team output and brand quality.

    • Partner with engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing partners from concept through production handoff, balancing brand, manufacturability, and cost.

    • Track tolerances, material call-outs, and vendor capabilities so design intent survives the path to production.

  • Partner across teams & mentor peers

    • Partner across design, engineering, and operations to drive creative cohesion on shared programs.

    • Lead discussions that clarify vision and priorities among cross-functional stakeholders.

    • Mentor peers and help elevate collaboration and craft standards across the design team.

  • Regulatory & compliance fluency

    • Develop working knowledge of relevant health and consumer product compliance and safety requirements (e.g., biocompatibility, electrical safety, packaging and labeling), and build them into your design process early.

    • Translate compliance and human-factors requirements into design criteria you and your engineering/regulatory partners can work from.

  • Creative craft & prototyping

    • Maintain hands-on fluency across sketching, 3D CAD (Rhino, SolidWorks, or Fusion 360), rendering (KeyShot or similar), and physical prototyping (3D printing, foam, soft-goods mockups).

    • Bring working fluency across materials and manufacturing processes — injection molding, overmolding, extrusion, sheet metal, soft goods — enough to make informed trade-offs with vendors and engineers.

You Have:

  • 8+ years in industrial design, with meaningful experience designing physical consumer or health/medical hardware that has shipped at scale.

  • A portfolio demonstrating expert craft across multiple creative disciplines, from concept sketches to shipped, manufactured products. (Please include a link to your portfolio with your application.)

  • Experience contributing to design systems, CMF standards, or frameworks that scale across multiple projects.

  • Demonstrated ability to resolve complex, ambiguous design problems across more than one initiative at a time.

  • Deep fluency in industrial design tools: sketching, 3D CAD (Rhino/SolidWorks/Fusion 360), rendering (KeyShot), and hands-on prototyping.

  • Working knowledge of manufacturing processes (injection molding, overmolding, extrusion, sheet metal, soft goods) and DFM principles.

  • Experience partnering directly with engineering and operations teams to take products from concept to production.

In the early 1900s, Sergei Diaghilev transformed ballet by bringing together extraordinary artists across disciplines. He paired Stravinsky with Picasso, Coco Chanel with choreographers, composers with painters. He wasn’t the person on stage, but he created the conditions that made extraordinary work possible. Every production demanded creative ambition, difficult tradeoffs, relentless coordination, and uncompromising standards.

Great creative production feels a lot like that.

Mercury is building a financial company that people genuinely love to use. We’re combining thoughtful design, technology, and AI to make financial workflows simpler, more powerful, and more human. Our Brand Creative team exists to bring that ambition to life through everything we make.

We’re looking for our first Executive Producer to establish Creative Production as a core capability within Brand Creative. You’ll lead production across our most ambitious campaigns and projects while building the systems and external network that allow exceptional creative work to happen again and again.

You see production as a creative discipline. You know how to protect bold ideas, challenge underdeveloped briefs, make difficult tradeoffs, and bring clarity to complexity. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who wants to build the function while still personally producing our biggest creative bets.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own production across Brand Creative campaigns and projects, balancing priorities, capacity, staffing, budgets, timelines, and risk across multiple concurrent initiatives.
  • Personally lead our most ambitious campaigns and selected projects from concept through delivery across film, photography, motion, experiential, digital, and integrated work.
  • Partner with creative leaders to turn ambitious ideas into production plans that hold up against timing, budget, and reality, challenging underdeveloped briefs and protecting the creative idea through execution.
  • Build and lead an exceptional network of agencies, directors, studios, photographers, freelancers, and production partners that expands our capacity without lowering the bar.
  • Establish how Brand Creative prioritizes, staffs, greenlights, reviews, and delivers projects, creating a production system that makes exceptional work more repeatable.
  • Bring clarity to complex projects by keeping creative leaders and cross-functional partners grounded in the real state of the work, decisions, constraints, tradeoffs, and risks.
  • Work directly with Brand Creative leadership to continually raise the quality of the work and build one of the strongest in-house creative teams in the industry.

What you’ll bring:

  • Significant experience leading complex, multidisciplinary creative production, with a track record of independently owning large-scale campaigns and multiple concurrent creative projects.
  • Deep production experience across film, photography, motion, experiential, digital, and integrated brand work, with the judgment to choose the right production model for the idea.
  • Strong financial and operational judgment, including experience with scoping, staffing, budgeting, forecasting, and managing meaningful production investments.
  • A track record of building production systems, capabilities, or ways of working, not simply operating within established ones.
  • Experience building and managing an exceptional network of agencies, production companies, directors, studios, freelancers, and vendors.
  • Strong creative judgment and the confidence to challenge briefs, protect ambitious ideas, and make difficult tradeoffs without losing sight of the work.
  • Exceptional communication and partnership skills across creative teams, marketers, executives, and external partners.
  • The ability to bring calm, clarity, and sound judgment to ambiguity. You're excited to build the function from the ground up and still want to personally produce the work.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

Amplitude is moving fast, from product analytics to an AI-native platform with agents embedded across the product, used by over 4,700 companies. We are looking for a strong design leader with a builder mindset to lead a 15-person design team through the next phase of growth.

This is a player-coach role. You manage and grow the team. You also stay in the actual work: elevating quality through feedback, pairing with designers on the hardest UX puzzles, and asking the right questions to unlock the crux of the problem. You'll know every product surface well enough to raise its quality — even if you don't own any single one end-to-end.

Designers are embedded in autonomous pods and need to keep shipping fast. Maintaining speed without compromising on coherence and quality is the job. If that tension sounds like an exciting problem to solve rather than a contradiction to complain about, keep reading.

What you'll do

Build the team. Hire, grow, and retain a high-performing design team, identifying people who will thrive and raise the bar at Amplitude. Develop them through direct, specific feedback. Help someone who's stuck get moving again.

Set direction. Drive the design strategy for Amplitude's product suite: Core Amplitude, Statsig, and Wave (a proactive agent that helps teams build self-improving products). Help define how agents and humans work together in the same workflows.

Champion craft. Strong visual design builds trust, clarity, and delight in the era of AI. Lead by example, elevating the quality of the product through exceptional design execution.

Hold a high bar. AI makes it cheap to ship UI changes, which makes it easy for quality to erode quietly. Set a clear standard for what good looks like and enforce it without becoming an approval bottleneck.

Stay in production. You believe that “the design” is what ships. Code is the material that brings the design to life. Push on the details, the papercuts, the edge cases.

Speak for the customer. Show up in leadership conversations as the voice of the customer, pushing for solutions that genuinely serve their needs and reduce complexity.

What we're looking for

  • You've managed senior, independent IC designers and earned their respect through product and craft judgment.

  • You've shipped products that moved real customer and business metrics, fast.

  • You've created (not inherited) structure inside of a messy, high-growth organization.

  • You've shipped AI-native experiences and use AI tools in your own practice today (we'll ask what you built and what you learned).

  • Your portfolio shows both systems-level thinking and pixel-level craft.

  • Bonus: You’ve designed for both technical and non-technical users, and can hold that tension without compromising the experience for either.

  • Bonus: Experience with Analytics, Experimentation, or Developer tools.

What this is not

  • Not an executive role that manages up and delegates down. You're deep in the work.

  • Not a pure IC role. You're accountable for a team of 15.

  • Not design ops. Your job isn't to add rituals, templates, or governance.

  • Not the approval committee. Pods keep moving; you create coherence without becoming the bottleneck.
